description: Unified utility to interact with redis instances.

parameters.name: ca_certs
parameters.description: Path to root certificates file. If not set and tls is set to true, certifi’s CA certificates are used.

parameters.name: client_cert_file
parameters.description: Path to the client certificate file.

parameters.name: client_key_file
parameters.description: Path to the client private key file.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: The selected redis command. config ensures a configuration setting on an instance. flush flushes all the instance or a specified db. replica sets a redis instance in replica or master mode. (slave is an alias for replica). Choices: "config" "flush" "replica" "slave"

parameters.name: db
parameters.description: The database to flush (used in DB mode) [flush command].

parameters.name: flush_mode
parameters.description: Type of flush (all the DBs in a redis instance or a specific one) [flush command]. Choices: "all" ← (default) "db"

parameters.name: login_host
parameters.description: Specify the target host running the database. Default: "localhost"

parameters.name: login_password
parameters.description: Specify the password to authenticate with. Usually not used when target is localhost.

parameters.name: login_port
parameters.description: Specify the port to connect to. Default: 6379

parameters.name: login_user
parameters.description: Specify the user to authenticate with. Requires redis >= 3.4.0.

parameters.name: master_host
parameters.description: The host of the master instance [replica command].

parameters.name: master_port
parameters.description: The port of the master instance [replica command].

parameters.name: replica_mode
parameters.description: The mode of the redis instance [replica command]. slave is an alias for replica. Choices: "master" "replica" ← (default) "slave"

parameters.name: tls
parameters.description: Specify whether or not to use TLS for the connection. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Specify whether or not to validate TLS certificates. This should only be turned off for personally controlled sites or with localhost as target. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: A redis config value. When memory size is needed, it is possible to specify it in the usual form of 1KB, 2M, 400MB where the base is 1024. Units are case insensitive, in other words 1m = 1mb = 1M = 1MB.

examples:
- name: Set local redis instance to be a replica of melee.island on port 6377
  community.general.redis:
    command: replica
    master_host: melee.island
    master_port: 6377

- name: Deactivate replica mode
  community.general.redis:
    command: replica
    replica_mode: master

- name: Flush all the redis db
  community.general.redis:
    command: flush
    flush_mode: all

- name: Flush only one db in a redis instance
  community.general.redis:
    command: flush
    db: 1
    flush_mode: db

- name: Configure local redis to have 10000 max clients
  community.general.redis:
    command: config
    name: maxclients
    value: 10000

- name: Configure local redis maxmemory to 4GB
  community.general.redis:
    command: config
    name: maxmemory
    value: 4GB

- name: Configure local redis to have lua time limit of 100 ms
  community.general.redis:
    command: config
    name: lua-time-limit
    value: 100

- name: Connect using TLS and certificate authentication
  community.general.redis:
    command: config
    name: lua-time-limit
    value: 100
    tls: true
    ca_certs: /etc/redis/certs/ca.crt
    client_cert_file: /etc/redis/certs/redis.crt
    client_key_file: /etc/redis/certs/redis.key
